$comment: SV-C23 / SV-C28 validator cases, generated by apps/agent-server/tests/agreement/validator_cases.py. Each case is one chat from an empty state: steps[] = the replies in order, each checked merged into the surfaces of the earlier VALID steps (an invalid step leaves the state as it was). expected.valid = the renderer state's verdict (@a2ui/agent RendererState over web_core + the project rules); nodeError = its error; pythonErrors = every problem the reference Python validator reports. A conforming validator gives the same verdict for every step. jsonOnlyKeywords: per function, args field ('' = the args object) -> JSON Schema keywords the renderer does not check (drop them, handover/README.md step 2).
